body:
## Pull request overview

Adds a floating (FAB-triggered) chatbot experience to `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, exposes related schema/types in `@object-ui/types`, and integrates the floating chatbot globally into the Console app layout.

**Changes:**
- Extends `ChatbotSchema` with floating-related fields and exports `FloatingChatbotConfig`.
- Implements floating chatbot UI (provider/trigger/panel + portal-based orchestrator) and registers a new `chatbot-floating` component type.
- Integrates the floating chatbot into `apps/console` and updates build config / changelog / tests.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 13 out of 13 changed files in this pull request and generated 8 comments.

<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/index.ts | Re-exports `FloatingChatbotConfig` from types package entrypoint. |
| packages/types/src/complex.ts | Extends `ChatbotSchema` with floating mode fields and defines `FloatingChatbotConfig`. |
| packages/plugin-chatbot/vite.config.ts | Updates Rollup externals to include `react/jsx-runtime`. |
| packages/plugin-chatbot/src/renderer.tsx | Registers `chatbot-floating` in the `ComponentRegistry` and defines its manifest metadata. |
| packages/plugin-chatbot/src/index.tsx | Exports floating chatbot components/hooks from the plugin package. |
| packages/plugin-chatbot/src/FloatingChatbotTrigger.tsx | Adds FAB trigger button component. |
| packages/plugin-chatbot/src/FloatingChatbotProvider.tsx | Adds context provider + `useFloatingChatbot()` hook for open/fullscreen state. |
| packages/plugin-chatbot/src/FloatingChatbotPanel.tsx | Adds floating dialog-like panel UI with header controls. |
| packages/plugin-chatbot/src/FloatingChatbot.tsx | Adds portal-based orchestrator wrapping `ChatbotEnhanced` in floating UI. |
| packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/FloatingChatbotWidgets.test.tsx | Adds trigger/panel interaction and basic a11y assertions. |
| packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/FloatingChatbotProvider.test.tsx | Adds provider/hook state tests. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents new floating chatbot capability and schema fields. |
| apps/console/src/components/ConsoleLayout.tsx | Integrates floating chatbot globally for authenticated console pages. |
</details>

**packages/plugin-chatbot/vite.config.ts:46**
* `rollupOptions.external` now includes `react/jsx-runtime`, but `output.globals` doesn’t map it. If this package emits a UMD build, consumers loading it via script tags may hit an undefined global for the JSX runtime. Add a `globals` entry for `react/jsx-runtime` (consistent with other packages) or switch `external` to a function that matches `react*` subpath imports and relies on ESM-only output.
```
    rollupOptions: {
      external: ['react', 'react/jsx-runtime', 'react-dom', '@object-ui/components', '@object-ui/core', '@object-ui/react', 'lucide-react'],
      output: {
        globals: {
          react: 'React',
          'react-dom': 'ReactDOM',
          '@object-ui/components': 'ObjectUIComponents',
          '@object-ui/core': 'ObjectUICore',
          '@object-ui/react': 'ObjectUIReact',
          'lucide-react': 'LucideReact',
        },
      },
```
</details>

`displayMode`/`floatingConfig` are added to `ChatbotSchema`, but there’s no implementation that uses `displayMode` to select floating vs inline rendering (a repo-wide search only finds this field in type/manifest metadata). Either wire `displayMode === 'floating'` into the existing `'chatbot'` renderer/component selection, or remove `displayMode` to avoid a misleading public API.

`FloatingChatbotConfig.triggerIcon` is documented as configurable (Lucide icon name), but there is no usage of `triggerIcon` anywhere in `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` (the trigger always renders `MessageCircle`). Either implement support for `triggerIcon` (and validate/limit allowed values) or remove it from the public config to keep the types/docs accurate.

The `chatbot-floating` manifest exposes a `displayMode` input/default, but the component type is already specific to the floating variant and `displayMode` is not used in rendering. This is likely to confuse schema authors and tooling. Consider removing `displayMode` from the `chatbot-floating` manifest inputs/defaultProps, or (preferably) making `displayMode` functional in the base `chatbot` renderer and deprecating the separate type.
```suggestion

```

`FloatingChatbotConfig` includes `triggerIcon`, but `FloatingChatbot` doesn’t read or pass any icon configuration down to the trigger. As a result, schema-driven `triggerIcon` changes will have no effect. Either plumb `triggerIcon` through to `FloatingChatbotTrigger` (and render the selected icon), or drop the option from the config.

The portal root creation/removal logic is a key behavior of `FloatingChatbot` (DOM insertion into `#floating-chatbot-portal`, cleanup on unmount), but there are no unit tests covering it. Add tests asserting that the portal container is created when missing, that content renders inside it, and that the container is not removed while still hosting children.

The trigger currently hardcodes the open-state icon to `MessageCircle`/`X` and doesn’t accept any icon prop. This makes `FloatingChatbotConfig.triggerIcon` (and future customization) impossible to implement without changing this component API. Consider adding a `triggerIcon`/`icon` prop (e.g., `React.ReactNode` or a constrained icon-name union) and using it here.

This panel is presented as a dialog (`role="dialog"`) but is missing common modal dialog accessibility hooks (e.g., `aria-modal="true"`, focus management, and an Escape-key close handler). Consider using the existing Radix/Shadcn Dialog/Sheet primitives (or replicating their behavior) so keyboard and screen-reader users can reliably interact with the overlay.

Unused import: `vi` is imported but never referenced in this test file. Remove it to avoid lint/TypeScript unused-import failures in stricter configurations.
```suggestion
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
```
